# A searchlight head: a drum 0.5 across and 0.42 long on a yoke, its lens facing -Y (hedra) = +Z
# (glTF), the game's forward; origin at the pivot. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Drum --base-color 0.196 0.325 0.373 --no-slot
material new Rim --base-color 0.043 0.541 0.561 --no-slot
material new Lens --base-color 0.188 0.882 0.725 --no-slot --emission 0.188 0.882 0.725
add mesh cylinder --name Drum --vertices 10 --radius 0.25 --depth 0.42 --location 0 0 0 --rotation 90 0 0
apply --rotation
material assign Drum
add mesh cylinder --name Rim --vertices 10 --radius 0.29 --depth 0.08 --location 0 -0.2 0 --rotation 90 0 0
apply --rotation
material assign Rim
add mesh cylinder --name Lens --vertices 10 --radius 0.21 --depth 0.06 --location 0 -0.24 0 --rotation 90 0 0
apply --rotation
material assign Lens
add mesh cube --name Yoke --size 1 --location 0 0.02 -0.2
scale 0.62 0.1 0.12
apply --scale
material assign Drum
select all
shade flat
export lamp.glb
